svg.title: Security: incident response
svg.desc: Detection raises a correlated alert. The SOC analyst triages it; false positives are tuned and closed. A true positive is declared by the incident commander, who starts three parallel tracks: the engineer contains the host, the analyst preserves evidence, and the commander notifies stakeholders on a fixed update cadence. After eradication and recovery, a post-incident review closes the incident.
svg.text: An alert is triaged, declared, contained in parallel with evidence preservation and communications, then reviewed.
Illustrative process. Lanes are roles; steps, thresholds and timings are examples, not policy.
